senses.definition: n.[m.] muster, appointment, appointed place;—abs. מ׳ only in שַׁעַר הַמּ׳ Ne 3:31, v. i. שַׁעַר; cstr. מִפְקַד:
muster of people 2 S 24:9 = 1 Ch 21:5.
appointment of (by) Hezekiah 2 Ch 31:13.
appointed place of (in) temple Ez 43:21 (Krae watch, guard-house; Köii 1, 93 conj. מוֹקֵד).
